property_summary: For every valid initialize(...) call, the contract's stored changeFee equals the provided _changeFee (i.e. changeFee == _changeFee); the mutant that assigns changeFee = _changeFee - 1 will make this equality false for at least some fuzzed _changeFee (e.g. any _changeFee > 0).
change_summary: Replace the assignment to changeFee with assigning changeFee = _changeFee - 1 (underflow checked by type), causing a different stored changeFee one less than input when possible.
